subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should Telegram recover an indefinitely guarded lane by escalating to a hard cancellation or process-restart boundary after a bounded timeout, rather than retaining the guard until the old handler settles?
rationale: The repository must choose the safety contract between avoiding concurrent same-lane handlers and bounding a user-visible inbound outage; the unmerged release-in-place approach shows this is not a mechanical cleanup decision.

options.title: Adopt hard-boundary recovery
options.body: Terminate or isolate the non-settling handler, verify that boundary, then release the lane and restart ingress with regression and live Telegram evidence.

options.title: Preserve strict guard ownership
options.body: Keep the guard until the original handler settles and document the longer outage behavior while collecting more incident evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt hard-boundary recovery
recommendation.body: Terminate or isolate the non-settling handler, verify that boundary, then release the lane and restart ingress with regression and live Telegram evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on Telegram polling-session recovery makes this the best available routing candidate for the recovery-policy choice.
